en.headline: August retail sales rise 5.6% to HK$32.1 billion
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said the gain was the 16th straight monthly increase, with online sales up 9.9%.
body: The value of Hong Kong's total retail sales in August was provisionally estimated at HK$32.1 billion, up 5.6 per cent from a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.

The revised figure for July was up 4.5 per cent year on year. For the first eight months of 2026, retail sales value was provisionally up 8.5 per cent from the same period in 2025. After price changes, the volume of sales in August rose 2.9 per cent from a year earlier, and volume for the first eight months was up 6.1 per cent.

Online sales accounted for 8.7 per cent of the August total. Their value was provisionally estimated at HK$2.8 billion, up 9.9 per cent from August 2025. Online sales for the first eight months were up 23.0 per cent year on year.

A government spokesman said the 5.6 per cent rise was a faster pace of growth and the 16th consecutive month of expansion, with gains across many types of outlets. By value, sales of jewellery, watches and valuable gifts rose 11.9 per cent from a year earlier, the department said.

zh.headline: 八月零售銷貨價值升5.6% 至321億元
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布臨時數字，按年升幅為連續第16個月擴張，網上銷售升9.9%。
body: 政府統計處星期五公布，2026年8月零售業總銷貨價值的臨時估計為321億元，較去年同月上升5.6%。
7月的修訂估計按年上升4.5%。今年首八個月合計，銷貨價值臨時估計較去年同期上升8.5%。扣除價格變動後，8月銷貨數量按年上升2.9%，首八個月合計上升6.1%。
8月網上銷售佔總銷貨價值8.7%，臨時估計為28億元，按年上升9.9%。首八個月網上銷售價值按年上升23.0%。
政府發言人表示，8月銷貨價值按年升5.6%，步伐加快，是連續第16個月擴張，多類零售商均見增長。統計處指，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物的銷貨價值按年上升11.9%。
